title: Item 15a · Going back: the back link
subtitle: Approved in each section — and a rule already exists. Rule v0.59: a back link “← [place]” sits above the page title, and “any rail section with sub-pages uses this same pattern.” Color Belt, Star, Black Belt and Camps follow it. Two approved screens don't: Forms' builder has a bare arrow button beside the title (its mockup, v0.235), and Finance's History has an outline “Back to the day” button (v0.197). (Color Belt's “← Color belt testing” under a “Testing” title goes away when Star goes live — already planned.) The rest of the page frame — the “view only” line, “Both schools”, and where settings live — comes next as 15b–15d. (Preview screenshots at PC size · fake data)

items.caption: 1. Camps (Color Belt, Star and Black Belt the same): “← Camps” above the title — the rule.
2. Forms' builder: a bare arrow beside the title — no words.
3. Finance's History: an outline “Back to the day” button beside the heading.

columns.label: Proposed (option B) · the v0.59 rule everywhere

items.caption: 4. Forms' builder: “← Forms” above the title.
5. Finance's History: “← Back to the day” above “History”.

columns.note: Copies what's already there: the back link Color Belt, Star, Black Belt and Camps use. Pictures 4–5 are drawn over the real pages; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question:
A · Keep as today. + no work. − “go back” looks three different ways; Forms' bare arrow has no words.
B · Recommended: the v0.59 rule everywhere (pictures 4–5). Forms' builder gets “← Forms” above its title; Finance's History gets “← Back to the day” above its heading. + “go back” is always in the same place and looks the same; the arrow gets its words. − two small changes (Forms, Finance).
